model_annotation: This line plot compares the "Missing Step" metric across five discrete points on the x-axis, labeled 0 through 4, for two conditions: "w.o. extension" and "extension". The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 4 with integer tick marks. The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step", is also linear, ranging from approximately 0.840 to 0.860, with tick marks at intervals of 0.005. The "w.o. extension" condition is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, which starts at approximately 0.860 at x=0 and decreases steadily to approximately 0.839 at x=4. The "extension" condition is represented by an orange solid line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 0.860 at x=0 and decreasing more gradually to approximately 0.841 at x=4. Both lines show a downward trend, with the "w.o. extension" line consistently below the "extension" line after x=0, indicating a lower "Missing Step" value for the former.
